name: ZCH_SOURCE_CONF_LEVELS_M
description: This table is used for storing the confidence levels in trading community objects and the attributes of these objects from different source systems. These confidence levels are used in the survivorship process.

columns.name: SOURCE_CONF_LEVEL_ID
columns.description: Source Confidence Level Id is a system generated id. Along with the date columns, it uniquely identifies a row

columns.name: SYNC_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: ESS Request Id for synchronization

columns.name: SYNC_FROM_DATE
columns.description: Last sync Date for synchronization

columns.name: SYNC_RECORD_ID
columns.description: ESS record ID for synchronization

columns.name: ENTITY_LEVEL
columns.description: This flag captures if the confidence level is for the entity (Y) or the entity/attribute combination (N)

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM_ID
columns.description: This is the  unique identifier in the hz_orig_systems table that identifies a source system.

columns.name: ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: This is the original system name of the source system.

columns.name: OBJ_NAME
columns.description: This column identifies the entity/object for which the source confidence level is being captured

columns.name: OBJ_DEF
columns.description: The object definition contains the full path of the VO corresponding to the object.

columns.name: TABLE_NAME
columns.description: The corresponding physical table name of the object.

columns.name: ATTRIBUTE_NAME
columns.description: This column identifies the attribute name in the entity for which the source confidence level is being captured.

columns.name: COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: This column captures the underlying physical column name of the VO attribute.

columns.name: CONFIDENCE_LEVEL
columns.description: The confidence level for the attribute/entity combination for a given source system. This ranges from 0-100, capturing the percentage.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the order of different changes made during a day. The lowest value represents the earliest change in the day.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_LATEST_CHANGE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: 'Y' indicates that this row represents the latest change in the day.
